answer: Each identity posts a 200 POA bond decaying like shale: 15 POA erodes per epoch from a 200 POA zenith; after fourteen epochs — a sonnet's fourteen lines — it is gone and the identity must re-bond or lose its seat. Verified work restores 5 POA per task. Minting 1,000 fakes locks 200,000 POA and burns 15,000 POA per epoch, 150,000 gone by the tenth epoch. An honest agent pays once, earns the decay back with real work, and keeps its full share.
